parameters.name: deploy_meeting_bot
parameters.description: Deploy a transcription bot to a Google Meet, Teams, or Zoom meeting and return the Vexa run ID for that session. Teams needs the full invitation link including the passcode. The instance decides the transcription language and the bot display name, so do NOT pass language or bot_name; use language_override ONLY when the user explicitly says the meeting is held in another language. If a bot is already in this meeting the call is refused rather than putting a second bot in the room; use force only after the user confirms the first one is gone. Remember the returned run ID and pass it to get_transcript as vexa_run_id.

value.meeting_url: ={{ $fromAI('meeting_url', 'Full meeting URL (Google Meet, Teams, or Zoom)', 'string') }}
value.language: ={{ $fromAI('language', 'Transcription language code (e.g. en, de). Optional, default auto-detect.', 'string') }}
value.bot_name: ={{ $fromAI('bot_name', 'Display name for the bot in the meeting. Leave empty to use the name configured for this instance.', 'string') }}
value.passcode: ={{ $fromAI('passcode', 'Meeting passcode for Teams or Zoom, if it is not already part of the URL. Optional.', 'string') }}
value.language_override: ={{ $fromAI('language_override', 'ONLY set this when the user explicitly says the meeting is held in a language other than the configured default. Leave empty otherwise.', 'string') }}
value.force: ={{ $fromAI('force', 'Set to true ONLY to deploy a bot although one is already in this meeting. Leave empty otherwise.', 'string') }}

parameters.name: get_transcript
parameters.description: Get the transcript of a meeting, grouped into speaker blocks with timestamps in the local time zone configured for this instance. CRITICAL: a recurring Teams or Zoom meeting reuses the same meeting ID for every session, and Vexa only ever serves the MOST RECENT run for a meeting ID. Always pass vexa_run_id, which deploy_meeting_bot returned when the bot was sent in; the tool then refuses rather than hand back a different session. Without it you may silently receive another meeting. Parameters: platform (google_meet/teams/zoom) and meeting_id, OR meeting_url; vexa_run_id (strongly recommended); from_time and to_time (HH:MM) to read part of a long meeting.

value.from_time: ={{ $fromAI('from_time', 'Only return the transcript from this wall clock time onwards, format HH:MM. Optional.', 'string') }}
value.to_time: ={{ $fromAI('to_time', 'Only return the transcript up to this wall clock time, format HH:MM. Optional.', 'string') }}
value.vexa_run_id: ={{ $fromAI('vexa_run_id', 'Vexa run ID returned by deploy_meeting_bot for this exact session. Pass it whenever you know it.', 'string') }}

parameters.name: share_transcript
parameters.description: Create a public, time limited link to a meeting transcript. Anyone holding the link can read the transcript until it expires, so only use it when the user explicitly asks to share. Parameters: platform and meeting_id, OR meeting_url.
